final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_rem, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_diff FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rem) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.avg_rem, g.avg_diff, g.avg_rem / o.overall AS ratio FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
